kpis.label: Global biotech VC funding, strongest first half since 2022; ~76% from rounds over $100M, inflated in part by Isomorphic Labs' single $2.1B round

kpis.sub: GUARDANT SHIELD TESTS · SCREENING GUIDANCE RAISED TO $218-230M
kpis.label: FDA approved a higher-throughput, lower-COGS Shield workflow now live in production, and UnitedHealthcare's Shield coverage takes effect this month — the multiomics diagnostics layer keeps compounding while AI-native platforms swing on single catalysts
Insilico's AI-discovered TNIK inhibitor remains the field's furthest clinical milestone; zero AI-discovered drugs have reached full FDA approval to date
Still ~81% below the ~$9B 2021 peak, but rebuilding as XBI/IBB/ARKG all post 45-77% trailing 1-yr total returns

themes.title: The least mature layer of the stack just got riskier
themes.description: Quantum-Si's Q2 revenue fell to $344K from $591K a year earlier, and the company delayed its Proteus commercial launch a full year to Q2 2027 while cutting headcount 20% to preserve cash. A useful counterweight to the tooling layer's otherwise strong quarter — hardware timelines slip just like clinical ones.

themes.title: Guardant and 908 Devices both delivered real operating progress
themes.description: Guardant Health's FDA-approved higher-throughput Shield workflow is now live in production and UnitedHealthcare coverage begins this month, with screening revenue guidance raised to $218-230M. 908 Devices grew Q2 revenue 23% to $16.1M, improved its adjusted EBITDA loss by more than half, and raised FY26 guidance to $68-70M — both picks-and-shovels names executing regardless of which drug-discovery platform wins.

themes.title: Third-party money is picking winners inside the AI-native tier
themes.description: H.C. Wainwright raised its Generate Biomedicines price target to $25 from $16 (Buy maintained) on Aug 6 despite a Q2 miss. Separately, ARK bought Schrödinger twice this week (Aug 11 and Aug 13, combined ~$826K) while trimming its 10x Genomics position — a vote for the platform with a real second (software) business.

themes.title: Eikon adds credibility but the stock overhang is unresolved
themes.description: Eikon Therapeutics appointed Merck's Johnny Bennett, Ph.D. — VP and Head of Discovery Chemistry at Merck Research Labs — to its Scientific Advisory Board on Aug 10. A genuine credibility add, but it doesn't offset the Aug 4 lock-up expiry or the two board resignations that preceded it; shares remain roughly 48% below the IPO price.

tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list. Catalysts here are partnerships, IND filings, and readouts — not revenue.

rows.watch for: Q2 (Aug 5): revenue fell to $7.67M from $19.22M (-60% YoY), net loss narrowed to $131.0M, cash opex guidance cut to under $375M; Genentech advanced the collaboration's first neuroscience target into joint early discovery, and REC-7735's IND cleared for a 2H26 Phase 1/2 ZINNIA trial start

rows.watch for: Q2 (Aug 6): net loss widened to $83.7M as R&D spend rose 20%; expanded its at-the-market equity facility from $250M to ~$463M the same day (Aug 6) — real dilution risk. Zovegalisib + atirmociclib Phase 3 targeted early 2027; $910.9M cash funds runway into 2029

rows.angle: Generative protein design — IPO'd Feb 27 2026 at $16/sh, $400M raised; separate $1B Novartis protein-design deal
rows.watch for: Q2 (Aug 6): loss widened to $67.3M (missed est.), but H.C. Wainwright raised its price target to $25 from $16 (Buy maintained) on Aug 6; GB-0895 Phase 3 asthma recruitment complete across all six global regions, Phase 1b COPD data still to come

rows.angle: Live-cell single-molecule tracking — upsized IPO Feb 4 2026 at $18/sh, $381M raised
rows.watch for: Added Merck's Johnny Bennett, Ph.D. (VP, Discovery Chemistry) to its Scientific Advisory Board Aug 10 — but that follows two board director resignations (effective Jul 31) and the Aug 4 lock-up expiry; shares remain ~48% below the $18 IPO offer

private_watchlist.name: Isomorphic Labs
private_watchlist.note: AlphaFold 3 lineage; Thrive Capital-led round adds MGX, Temasek, CapitalG & UK Sovereign AI Fund alongside Alphabet/GV. ISM8969 cleared FDA for human trials Jan 28, 2026 — the oncology candidate CEO Demis Hassabis says will anchor Isomorphic's first clinical trials by year-end 2026, a year later than his original 2025 target.

private_watchlist.name: Insilico Medicine
private_watchlist.note: Formally initiated the Phase III GENESIS-IPF trial for rentosertib on Jul 7, 2026 — 320 patients, 52 weeks, 47 centers across China; the Phase IIa data behind it (published in Nature Medicine) showed +98.4 mL forced vital capacity improvement at 12 weeks on the 60mg arm. Still the field's clearest clinical proof point; listed on HKEX (Dec 2025, $292M IPO).

private_watchlist.name: Xaira Therapeutics
private_watchlist.note: Launched X-Cell, its first virtual cell model (4.9B parameters, trained on the X-Atlas/Pisces dataset), in March 2026. Built out its clinical leadership Jul 6 — Ci Chu to Chief Discovery Officer, Bo Wang to Chief AI Scientist, plus a new SVP of Translational Science & Early Clinical Development — a tell that it's moving from platform-building toward actually running trials.

private_watchlist.name: NewLimit
private_watchlist.note: Epigenetic reprogramming for longevity (Founders Fund, Lilly Ventures, Jun 2026); cites a prototype that reverses aging in human liver cells, targeting clinical entry as early as 2027. Retro Biosciences ($1.8B valuation, $3B+ raised) has an Alzheimer's Phase 1 trial (RTR242, autophagy-targeting) underway in Australia with early safety data expected around August — CEO Joe Betts-LaCroix says the trial is going well with no dose-limiting toxicities so far.

bear_case.title: Biology still fails in the clinic
bear_case.description: Zero AI-discovered drugs have reached full FDA approval — rentosertib's Phase III initiation (Jul 7) is the field's furthest milestone, not a finish line. Recursion's Q2 revenue fell 60% YoY to $7.67M, missing estimates; management responded by cutting 2026 cash opex guidance to under $375M rather than promising a near-term revenue fix.

bear_case.title: Catalyst-driven volatility
bear_case.description: These stocks trade on announcements; between catalysts they drift and dilute. Generate Biomedicines missed Q2 estimates and widened its loss, yet H.C. Wainwright raised its price target to $25 from $16 the same day. Eikon added a credible Merck scientific advisor on Aug 10, but that followed two board resignations and an Aug 4 lock-up expiry — shares sit ~48% below IPO with no clinical catalyst yet to offset the overhang.

bear_case.title: Hardware and instrument risk isn't just a biology problem
bear_case.description: Quantum-Si's Aug 13 disclosure that Proteus won't launch until Q2 2027 — a full year late — alongside a 20% workforce cut, is a reminder that the proteomics layer's timelines slip just like clinical ones. Compare that to Abbott's ~$21B all-cash purchase of Exact Sciences: real test volumes and reimbursed CPT codes command real M&A premiums, while unproven instrument platforms carry genuine execution risk regardless of the underlying science.

bear_case.title: Rate sensitivity
bear_case.description: Long-duration biotech cash flows are highly sensitive to rates; macro can swamp fundamentals regardless of platform progress. Relay Therapeutics' Aug 6 expansion of its at-the-market equity facility to ~$463M is a reminder that unprofitable platform names fund themselves by diluting shareholders when capital is available, not necessarily when it's cheap.

catalysts.title: Quantum-Si (QSI) Q2 2026: Proteus delayed to Q2 2027, 20% workforce cut
catalysts.description: Revenue fell to $344K from $591K a year earlier; the company is adding an integrated instrument design cycle to reduce manufacturing risk. Same week, ARK bought more Schrödinger (SDGR) and trimmed 10x Genomics across its funds.

catalysts.title: Eikon Therapeutics (EIKN) adds Merck's Johnny Bennett, Ph.D. to Scientific Advisory Board
catalysts.description: VP and Head of Discovery Chemistry at Merck Research Labs joins a board that already includes Nobel laureates Eric Betzig and Thomas Cech — a credibility add that doesn't resolve the recent lock-up/board-resignation overhang.

catalysts.title: Relay Therapeutics (RLAY) expands ATM offering to ~$463M; Generate Biomedicines (GENB) price target raised to $25
catalysts.description: Relay grew its at-the-market equity capacity from $250M to ~$463M the same day it reported a widened Q2 net loss. H.C. Wainwright raised its Generate Biomedicines target to $25 from $16 (Buy) despite a Q2 miss, citing Novartis's advancement of a platform-designed biologic into preclinical.

catalysts.title: Recursion (RXRX) Q2 2026: Genentech advances first neuroscience target; REC-7735 IND cleared
catalysts.description: Revenue missed by ~60% YoY, but Genentech moved the collaboration's first neuroscience target into joint early discovery, and REC-7735 (a PI3Kα H1047R inhibitor designed in 10 months) cleared IND for a Phase 1/2 ZINNIA trial start in 2H26.

catalysts.title: Guardant Health (GH): FDA approves higher-throughput Shield workflow; UnitedHealthcare coverage begins
catalysts.description: The lower-COGS Shield workflow went live in production for new samples in August; UnitedHealthcare's Shield coverage takes effect the same month. Screening revenue guidance raised to $218-230M on 270-285K expected tests.

positions.name: Eli Lilly
positions.note: Q2 revenue hit $23.0B (+48%) on Mounjaro and Zepbound, FY26 guidance raised to $85–87B; Verve Therapeutics (acquired 2025) is prioritizing the Heart-2 trial for VERVE-102, pushing in-vivo gene editing from rare disease toward mainstream cardiovascular — optionality stacked on top of cash flow that doesn't need it to work.

positions.name: Novartis
positions.note: Q2 sales +3% to $14.4B with guidance reaffirmed; deep AI partnerships across the pipeline (Isomorphic, Chai Discovery, Relation Therapeutics) are backed by pharma economics rather than a platform story.

positions.name: NVIDIA
positions.note: BioNeMo and the Lilly co-innovation lab (~7 months into build-out) make it the compute layer for nearly every AI-biotech platform on this page. It also sits in your AI, Robotics and Quantum sleeves — don't double-count the exposure across sleeves.

positions.name: Illumina
positions.note: Q2 revenue $1.16B (+9.5%) with FY26 outlook lifted to $4.60–4.64B; refinanced its September debt maturity with a new $300M notes offering (Aug 10) and syndicated credit facility (Aug 13) — routine balance-sheet management from the sequencing incumbent that monetizes every experiment regardless of which drug-discovery platform wins.

positions.name: Schrödinger
positions.note: ARK bought SDGR twice this week (Aug 11 ~$301K, Aug 13 ~$525K) while trimming 10x Genomics — a vote of confidence alongside Q2's ACV +27% and the new Bunsen agentic co-scientist; still the AI-native name with a real second business (software revenue) to fall back on.

positions.name: Recursion
positions.note: Q2 revenue fell 60% YoY to $7.67M, but net loss narrowed to $131.0M and cash opex guidance was cut to under $375M for cost discipline, while Genentech advanced the first neuroscience target into joint early discovery — the platform is proving targets faster than it's proving revenue.

positions.name: Relay Therapeutics
positions.note: Net loss widened 20% in Q2 and the company expanded its at-the-market equity facility from $250M to ~$463M the same day (Aug 6) — real dilution risk layered on the existing binary bet, though $910.9M cash and a concrete Phase 3 timeline (early 2027) keep the science genuine.

positions.name: Generate Biomedicines
positions.note: H.C. Wainwright raised its price target to $25 from $16 (Buy maintained) on Aug 6 despite a Q2 miss, and GB-0895's Phase 3 asthma recruitment is now complete across all six regions with Phase 1b COPD data still to come — third-party conviction is building faster than the loss is narrowing.

positions.name: 908 Devices
positions.note: Q2 revenue +23% to $16.1M, adjusted EBITDA loss improved more than 50% YoY, $101.5M cash with no debt, and FY26 guidance raised to $68-70M on a new $6M ProtectIR order — the strongest print of any tooling name this quarter, still sized small because it's a single-digit-million-revenue business.

positions.name: Tempus AI
positions.note: Rolled out a new multimodal foundation model (Aug 4) claiming diagnostic-grade cancer detection and broader biomarker prediction, and is now in patent litigation with Guardant Health testing whether AI-diagnostic patents are even valid — a genuinely strong data-network business still priced for continued perfection; wait for a better entry.

positions.name: Guardant Health
positions.note: FDA approved a higher-throughput, lower-COGS Shield workflow now live in production, and UnitedHealthcare's Shield coverage takes effect this month — real execution, but shares trade near a 52-week high after a ~200% trailing 1-year run, so price still leads the story here.

positions.name: Eikon Therapeutics
positions.note: Added Merck's Johnny Bennett, Ph.D. to its Scientific Advisory Board Aug 10 — a credible addition — but it doesn't resolve the Aug 4 lock-up overhang or the two board resignations that preceded it, and shares remain ~48% below the $18 IPO price with no near-term clinical catalyst.

positions.name: Quantum-Si
positions.note: Q2 revenue fell to $344K from $591K a year earlier, and the company delayed its Proteus commercial launch a full year to Q2 2027 while cutting headcount 20% to preserve cash — the least mature layer of the multiomics stack just got materially riskier, not more proven; moved out of Speculative until the timeline stabilizes.
